content:
Sorry for nagging on the PCB design, but routing fine signal wires right under a hole that is actively used to screw mount the PCB somewhere does not feel right. I wonder how many people will damage the insulation in the installation, having weird errors later. Maybe Prusa can fix this for future revisions.

Btw. I also agree that the sticker is likely placed more easily now than in step 96/97 ( https://help.prusa3d.com/guide/5-spoolholders-tool-dock-assembly_1096255#1109230)
There is a protective decal applied to the top surface towards the end of the build. It is easier to apply at this point in the procedure.
The cable goes at the front right, not the back
Prusa INDX set version of the offset-sensor-holder has an additional aliment wall on the screw side instead on the opposite side
